reference.question: Walk 40 meters north from the school gate, then 10 meters south. How many meters north of the school gate are you now? Calculate: \(40 - 10 = ?\)
reference.solution:
Method 1: Subtract the return distance

Walking south means going back: \(40 - 10 = 30\).
